D.label: DOOR
D.name: Lab door
D.text: The lab door. It opens when the pre-lab is done.

N.label: NOTICE
N.name: Notice board
N.text: Today: how does a cart's acceleration change with the fan force, and with the mass? The door light turns green when your pre-lab is done.

C.label: STEP CARD
C.name: Step card
C.text: The step card lists every step of the lab, in order.

B.label: BAR SHELF
B.name: Mass bar shelf
B.text: Mass bars. Take four. Each bar is for loading the cart.

W.label: BALANCE
W.name: Balance
W.text: The balance reads a mass in kg. Read the cart and one bar.

T.label: TRACK
T.name: Fan cart track
T.text: The track, the fan cart, the force sensor and the motion sensor. Press E to open the notebook.

newArt: track (four tiles wide: rail, cart with fan on top, bars stacked on the cart, motion sensor at the far end)
